chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, when He intends goodness for a servant, marks a white spot in his heart, opens the ears of his heart, and assigns an angel to guide him; and when He intends evil for a servant, marks a black spot in his heart, closes the ears of his heart, and assigns a Satan to mislead him.

key_terms.يُسَدِّدُهُ: guides him to the right path

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual signs of divine guidance and misguidance in the heart according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi elucidates the metaphysical mechanism of divine guidance (tawfiq) and misguidance (tafsiq) through the metaphor of 'white' and 'black' marks (nukat) on the heart, a concept central to Shia hadith literature. It highlights the role of angelic assistance in facilitating spiritual receptivity, contrasting with the devil's role in closing the heart's faculties, thereby emphasizing the interplay between divine will and human spiritual state.

en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Humran, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, when He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Intends goodness with a servant, Imprints a white spot in his heart and Opens the ears of his heart, and Allocates an Angel with him guiding him; and when He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Intends evil with a servant, Imprints a black spot in his heart, and Shuts the ears of his heart, and Allocates a Satan<sup style="font-weight: normal">la</sup> with him to stray him’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Humran from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, wills good for a servant. He places a white dot on his heart, opens up his ears and heart and assigns an angel to keep him on the right path. When He wills evil for a servant. He places a black dot in his heart and shuts down his ears and heart and assigns a Satan to mislead him.”
